rule: face and split beats also have "gesture": a short direction for the avatar's hands and body during that beat, tied to a spoken word where it helps, e.g. "Raises one open palm at chest height on 'first', then nods on 'works'."
Use one or two natural gestures per beat that fit what is said (open palms, pointing at the camera, a small shrug, a nod, leaning in) and vary them between beats.
Keep the hands in front of the chest and inside the frame for the whole gesture; do not bring them up from below the frame or drop them out of it.
Describe only hands, arms, head and posture, never the mouth or face.

constraints: Throughout the clip the person looks exactly as in the photo: same face, hair, glasses and clothes.
Both hands are bare and empty, with plain skin, bare wrists and five natural fingers on each hand, and they look the same every time they appear.
